column1: # Emotion bank recording script (2026-11-15): 8 moods x 10 sentences, about 1 minute each.
# Not recorded (the founder could not record): the emotion bank is bootstrapped from these texts instead,
# see data/eval/emo_seed.tsv and docs/ROADMAP.md. Still ready for a real recording session later.
# The id shows the mood (neytral_01, iliq_01, ...). Read each block in that mood, the way you would really talk
# to a person: natural, medium strength, never theatrical. Same microphone, room and distance as ref.wav.
# Format: id<TAB>text. If you change a word while reading, fix the text in the studio (E) so it matches.

column2: Bugun darsimizda o'tgan zamon fe'llarini takrorlaymiz.
